why: Drops the scene pairing, which is the whole reason the flag is guarded. Every other moment renders a tank that never refuses a shot, so --blocked-fire on one produces a clip with no cue in it -- indistinguishable from an arm that does nothing, and exactly the failure this tooling exists to end (the arena captures that showed nothing were what prompted it).
killedBy: gallery args takes a blocked-fire cue only for the moment that stages a refusal
